sanskrit: yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena syād iti | tasyaivaṃ nir vapet tasyaivaṃ nirupyaivam evānu nirvapet | tadaiva sa pāpīyān ātmanā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena bhavati- idamidaṃ kuryāt sā prāyaścītiḥ ||
english: Whomsoever one desires to make inferior in self, in progeny, in livestock, in household, and in wealth — for him one should perform this oblation, and having performed it thus, one should follow it with this same oblation. Thereupon he indeed becomes inferior in self, in livestock, in household, and in wealth. This one should do: that is the expiation-rite.

sanskrit: yaṃ kāmayeta na vasīyān na śreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena syād iti | tasyaivaṃ nir vapet tasyaivaṃ nirupayaivam evānu nirvapet | tadaiva sa na vasīyān na śreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena bhavati- idamidaṃ kuryāt sa prāyaścittiḥ ||
english: Whomsoever one desires to make neither wealthier nor better in self, in progeny, in livestock, in household, and in wealth — for him one should perform this oblation, and having performed it thus, one should follow it with this same oblation. Thereupon he indeed becomes neither wealthier nor better in self, in progeny, in livestock, in household, and in wealth. This one should do: that is the expiation-rite.

sanskrit: yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyāñ chreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena syād iti | tasyaivaṃ nir vapet tasyaivaṃ nirupyaivam evānu nirvapet | tadaiva sa vasīyāñ chreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena bhavati- idamidaṃ kuryāt sā prāyaścittiḥ ||
english: Whomsoever one desires to make wealthier and better in self, in progeny, in livestock, in household, and in wealth — for him one should perform this oblation, and having performed it thus, one should follow it with this same oblation. Thereupon he indeed becomes wealthier and better in self, in progeny, in livestock, in household, and in wealth. This one should do: that is the expiation-rite.

sanskrit: yad avahanyamānasya taṇḍula skandati samāṃsamāmasya varaḥ pramāyuko bhavati ||
english: When, as the grain is being husked, a rice-grain leaps out — the best kinsman of the same flesh becomes subject to death.
When the cooking-pot is not properly mounted, one performs a rite belonging to the Fathers.

sanskrit: yad viṣyandate gṛhāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca payo vi ṣyandate ||
english: When it drips and overflows — the milk of the household and of the livestock drips away.

sanskrit: yad apasiñcati gṛhāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca payo 'pa siñcati ||
english: When one pours it off prematurely — the milk of the household and of the livestock is poured away.
When the stirring-stick crumbles — the householder dies.
When the ladle crumbles — the mistress of the house dies.

sanskrit: yat kumbhī vikasati sarvajyānir dātā ca pratigṛhītā ca jīyete ||
english: When the pot cracks open — total loss ensues: both the giver and the receiver suffer defeat.

sanskrit: yat prāñcam udvartayati yajñāya ca devebhyaś cā vṛścate ||
english: When one stirs it upward toward the east — it is cut off for the sacrifice and for the gods.

sanskrit: yad dakṣiṇāñcam udvartayati yamāya ca pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate ||
english: When one stirs it upward toward the south — it is cut off for Yama and for the Fathers.

sanskrit: yat pratyañcam udvartayati varuṇāyāpsuṣada ā vṛścate ||
english: When one stirs it upward toward the west — it is cut off for Varuṇa, the one who dwells in the waters.

sanskrit: yad udañcam udvartayati somāya ca rājñe saptaṛṣibhyaś cā vṛścate ||
english: When one stirs it upward toward the north — it is cut off for Soma the king and for the Seven Seers.

sanskrit: yad anuvṛttam uddharati diśodiśa evainaṃ bhayam ā gacchati ||
english: When one lifts it out with a circular motion — fear comes to him from every direction.
